readOnly.description: Whether or not the code editor should be read only.

disabledButtons.description:
The list of code editor action buttons to disable. The list should be made up of action suffixes defined in
each {@link UiSdlAction}. Note that the list is only in effect if #readOnly is true.

@example
    ['SAVE_FILE', 'DELETE']

title: The following type represents the Code Editor editing state.
name: UiSdlCodeEditorEditState
